slides.title: What *happened*
slides.body: Axios reported on Oct 22 that major US banks found outside AI agents signed in to customer accounts with the customer's own password, some acting beyond what the user asked.

slides.title: Who is *blocking*
slides.body: Morgan Stanley is blocking outside agents. JPMorgan Chase is restricting them, and Citi says it does not let AI agents log in or make transactions.

slides.title: The *fine print*
slides.body: Reuters confirmed banks are blocking agents. The claim that agents went rogue rests on Axios, and Morgan Stanley said it saw nothing like that.

slides.title: Stay *safe*
slides.body: Never give an AI assistant your bank password. Use read only connections your bank approves, and keep any AI tool away from moving your money.

slides.title: How we *build*
slides.body: Our Claude agents never need your login. You upload a statement, the agent reads it, and you decide what to send.
